title: RulesDocument
description: The rules that would judge a set of paths.

schema_version.description: The version of this document's shape.

paths.description:
The paths asked about (relative to the working directory, forward
slashes): the named paths, or under `--diff` the changed paths a
`lint --diff` would judge.

agents.description:
Each agent that judges at least one listed rule, once, in the order its
first rule appears.

rules.description: The rules whose scoping matches at least one path, in config order.

AgentEntry.description: An agent that judges at least one listed rule.

name.description: The agent's name (`default` for rules that name none).

framing.description:
The reviewer context the agent's prompt gives it (its `prompt_template`),
empty when it sets none.

RuleEntry.description: A rule that would judge at least one of the paths.

agent.description: The agent that judges it (an entry in `agents`).

paths.description: The paths this rule's scoping matches, a subset of the document's `paths`.
